correctness.rationale: After XOR by the first seed, fixing all seeds permits exactly coordinate permutations within equal-signature blocks. Their orbit keys are Hamming weights in these blocks. Up to d rounds of 1-WL recover the exact seed-distance vector, and one more round distinguishes every signed coordinate-direction vector and its multiplicity, thereby recovering every block weight. The opposite orbit inclusion follows from automorphism invariance. Counts, binomial class sizes and the sharp mark minimum follow. Finite checker corroborates 7030 instances without substitution for general proof.

value.rationale: The uniform characterization of all stabilizer-orbit colour classes under arbitrary landmark choices is a motivated structural finite-model-theory problem, not merely a known fixing-number restatement: a determining set only destroys automorphisms, whereas discrete WL is strictly stronger in general. The exact binomial orbit profile and explicit d+1 recovery bound provide a reusable positive criterion for colour refinement on the full Boolean-cube family.
